company.name: Analog Devices, Inc.
company.fiscalCalendar: Fiscal quarters use ADI's 52/53-week reporting calendar; FY2026Q2 ended 2026-05-02.

sources.title: Fiscal Second Quarter Financial Results and Third Quarter Outlook

businessModel.claim: ADI is a global semiconductor company combining analog, digital, AI and software technologies for intelligent-edge applications.

productsAndCustomers.claim: ADI sells sensing, signal-chain, power, connectivity and related semiconductor solutions into industrial, automotive, communications and consumer markets.

segmentsAndGeographies.claim: The release identifies Industrial, Automotive and Communications as B2B end markets and describes ADI as a global semiconductor leader.

fiscalCalendar.claim: Fiscal second quarter 2026 ended on 2026-05-02; the requested forecast period is the following fiscal quarter.

revenueAndCostDrivers.claim: Management links the Q3 revenue outlook to growing demand and record bookings across Industrial, Automotive and Communications.

accountingDefinitions.claim: The release separates reported and adjusted measures and defines adjusted gross margin and adjusted diluted EPS as non-GAAP measures.

guidanceStyle.claim: ADI gives Q3 revenue as a point estimate with a plus-or-minus range and gives EPS and margin outlooks on stated reported or adjusted bases.

cyclicalityAndSeasonality.claim: ADI identifies semiconductor demand, market conditions and business cycles as factors that can change actual results.

externalExposures.claim: The filing identifies tariffs, trade restrictions, geopolitics, demand conditions and supply-chain disruptions as external risks.

signalMap.hypothesis: The latest filed Q3 revenue outlook is the strongest direct starting range.
Current bookings commentary helps judge where results may fall inside guidance but has no calibrated standalone weight.
Management's target-period demand view contextualizes the revenue range without creating false precision.
A tariff should create a numeric scenario only when enactment timing and revenue exposure are both quantified.
